title: ReferenceVerificationInput
description: Either a bare array of reference rows to verify, or a request naming a scope to collect them from.

scope.description: Directory to walk and collect references: maps from, the way collect-set-of-references.mjs does.

includeGlobs.description: Glob patterns (`*`, `**`, `?`) filtering collected rows to those whose relative path matches at least one pattern.

doi.description: Digital object identifier; absent or null rows are reported no-doi.
